about: Postings open to someone in the Philippines, in words the rules do not know. A model that excludes these hides real jobs; the eval reports it but does not fail on it.

cases.title: Full Stack Engineer
cases.description:
Tidepool Tools builds scheduling software for surf schools.

Our team spans 14 countries and we hire wherever you have a stable internet connection. We pay in USD through Deel.

You will work across our React frontend and Elixir backend.
cases.why: Hires in any country, without the word worldwide.

cases.title: Content Designer
cases.description:
Sari Commerce helps neighborhood shops sell online.

We hire contractors in Southeast Asian countries and work on GMT+7 to GMT+9 hours.

You will write onboarding flows and help center articles.
cases.why: Southeast Asian countries, written as an adjective the APAC rule does not match.

cases.title: DevOps Engineer
cases.description:
Copperline hosts websites for nonprofits.

We are unable to sponsor visas, but we hire contractors in any country where our payment provider operates.

You will own Terraform, CI and our monitoring.
cases.why: "Unable to sponsor visas" sounds like an exclusion, but it only rules out relocation.
